notes:
- Company: HoneyOak SemanticWorks — mid-market knowledge SaaS (B2B) building contextual search and in-app recommendations.
- Short summary: evaluating Redwood hosted API to validate quality/cost for embeddings + semantic search. If POC meets throughput and unit-cost goals, plan to move to Dedicated (reserved capacity) for production.
- POC scope: nightly batch ingestion of ~1.2M documents (3M paragraphs) to generate embeddings, plus online query traffic ~150 QPS (peaks 250 QPS) with 50ms retrieval target. Need vector DB integration (they currently use Pinecone but open to comparing RW-managed options).
- Performance asks: bulk embed pipeline throughput target >= 10k embeddings/min for batch jobs (overnight windows), 95th percentile online search latency < 70ms (prefer <50ms).
- Models: prefer open/model-agnostic stack (quantized Llama/E1) for cost control but want Redwood-verified performance numbers; ask for fallback routing to smaller models under load.
- Security/legal: require SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, and optional EU residency for a subset of customer data. Legal sent standard security appendix; waiting on Redwood security FAQ answers (see Drive doc).
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement — strong push to keep ARR in $75k–$200k band. Need transparent token/embedding unit economics. Asked for Dedicated pricing sheet + example TCO vs hosted for 6/12/24 months.
- Quotes from call: "We need predictable monthly cost — bursts ok but can't have surprise token bills." — Head of Product.
- Integration notes: engineering prefers to continue using Pinecone today; interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and caching to lower unit cost.
- POC success criteria (agreed): 1) match quality parity with current embedding model (recall @10 >= baseline), 2) achieve batch throughput targets for nightly job, 3) sustained online latency SLOs under 150 QPS, 4) acceptable TCO vs current solution.
- Internal champions: Head of Product (Claire R.), Staff ML Engineer (Samir Patel).
- Risk: procurement timeline aligned to Q2 budget; legal still clarifying residency + liability.
- Next steps: finalize POC dataset, Redwood to deliver Dedicated pricing scenarios (3 configs: single-shard, multi-shard dedicated pool, dedicated + burst); schedule 2-week POC (hosted) kickoff and run evaluation on production-like traffic.
- Stubs/links: drive deck (pricing), security FAQ, ff transcripts attached.
